story.title: The Scapegoat Contract
story.logline: After serving years in prison to pay off stranger's crimes, a young man returns home only to discover his mother bought him as an infant to take the fall for her real son.
story.theme: Identity, deceptive love, and systemic sacrifice
story.twist: The protagonist's mother adopted him solely to serve as a legal shield for her high-profile biological son.
story.ending: As police break down the door to arrest him for a new murder he didn't commit, he realizes his entire existence was engineered for sacrifice.

scenes.narration: Your mother paid me to hate you. In our dystopian city, wealthy elites hire professional scapegoats to absorb their worst crimes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket and a glowing brass collar, stands in a dim futuristic concrete alleyway beneath rain and flickering neon lights.

scenes.narration: I spent my youth locked inside high-security isolation vaults, carrying heavy sentences for rich strangers I never even met.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket and a glowing brass collar, sits on a cold bench inside a metallic prison cell surrounded by blue holographic security bars.

scenes.narration: My heavy brass collar logged every transferred felony while my real mother waited faithfully in our dim, crumbling apartment.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Extreme close-up of Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket, touching the glowing brass collar wrapped tightly around his neck in a dark corridor.

scenes.narration: Today, I finally paid off my final debt and walked home, clutching my clean slate certificate in my hands.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket and a glowing brass collar, walks down a shadowy apartment hallway holding a glowing paper certificate.

scenes.narration: My mother wept as she embraced me, whispering that I was her brave hero who saved our family from starving.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket and a glowing brass collar, is embraced warmly by his elderly mother inside a dim, retro-styled apartment.

scenes.narration: While she brewed tea, I searched for an old photo and found a locked metal box inside her closet.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket and a glowing brass collar, opens a hidden rusty box inside a cluttered closet of the dim apartment.

scenes.narration: Inside lay a stamped contract from the Scapegoat Registry, stamped twenty years ago, carrying my own baby footprints.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket and a glowing brass collar, stares down in shock at an official legal document stamped with black ink footprints.
scenes.camera: Tight close-up on hands and document

scenes.narration: She never birthed me. She bought an orphan to serve as a lifelong sacrificial shield for her actual biological son.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket and a glowing brass collar, gazes at a framed photo of a handsome politician on the desk in the dim apartment.
scenes.camera: Panning shot from document to photo

scenes.narration: Her real son is the city mayor—and my brand-new clean slate was just erased to absorb his murder charge.
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket, gasps as the brass collar on his neck turns bright warning red, alarming loudly inside the dim apartment.

scenes.narration: As police smash through the door, I wonder: if love is bought, who pays for your sins?
scenes.visual_prompt: Vertical 9:16 footage. Ethan, a 22-year-old man with messy dark hair, wearing a faded olive green jacket and red-glowing brass collar, turns to face heavy tactical police breaching the entrance of the dim apartment.

caption.hook: I was bought just to go to prison.
caption.title: The Scapegoat Contract
caption.caption:
Twelve years behind bars for a crime I didn't commit, only to learn the woman who raised me orchestrated the whole thing. Blood isn't always thicker than a rigged legal system.

Would you ever forgive a parent who treated your life as disposable?
